prompts.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one finished landscape destination illustration for the cozy fantasy discovery game 'Le monde tient dans une valise'. Create exactly one full-bleed horizontal image, 4:3 aspect ratio, target 1024x768. Shared series style: polished hand-painted 2D cartoon storybook art, gently rounded toy-like forms, confident soft dark-brown outlines, flat color masses with restrained soft shading, warm cream highlights, subtle magical atmosphere. Clearly illustrated, not 3D rendered or photorealistic, not pixel art. Three simple depth layers maximum, a strong unique landscape silhouette and a single focal area, readable at 300px wide and as a small postcard thumbnail. Keep the important subject inside the middle 80% of the frame. Restrained amount of detail; no busy texture, no micro-detail. The full landscape fills the rectangle, not an isolated floating diorama. No people, no characters, no suitcase, no compass, no interface, no card border, no text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark. Subject: L'Archipel d'Azur, a small fantastical tropical archipelago born from water and a palm tree. A broad turquoise lagoon curves around one welcoming cream-sand island crowned by a few stylized palms with curved trunks and broad green fronds; two smaller rounded islands recede into the distance. Composition: elevated three-quarter landscape view over the lagoon, one main island as the focal shape, sweeping open water and soft distant sky. Sea visibly shifts from clear mint shallows to azure blue, with a few clean curling white ripples and tiny golden sparkles. Bright sunlit, peaceful, inviting, subtly enchanted. Palette: turquoise, azure, mint green, warm sand and peach highlights. No buildings, boats, volcanoes or mushrooms.

Subject: Mycélia, a magical mushroom village nestled among the roots of a few giant rounded trees. The focal shape is a small cluster of large, distinct mushroom houses: broad plum and dusty-coral caps, creamy stems, a few warm glowing windows integrated into the stems. A soft mossy path curves toward the central mushroom house; rounded tree trunks frame the edges and a leafy canopy opens above. Composition: intimate eye-level view from the forest floor, large mushroom silhouettes, no distant panoramic mountain landscape. A handful of luminous spores drift under the caps, quiet twilight filtered through leaves. Welcoming and curious, never eerie or scary. Palette: plum, lavender, moss green, muted coral and warm golden window light. No people, no animals, no water lagoon or lava.

Subject: Le Cœur de braise, a fantastical volcanic landscape born from fire and rock. A broad rounded basalt crater forms the main focal shape; its open glowing center resembles a warm ember, with one slow ribbon of golden-orange lava flowing toward the foreground between smooth dark-purple rocks. A few short basalt columns and soft smoky shapes provide simple framing, with a dusk sky receding behind. Composition: slightly elevated view into the glowing crater, one strong circular crater silhouette, clear contrast between warm molten gold and cool plum stone. Tiny embers drift gently; an enchanted inner warmth, awe and calm rather than danger. Palette: deep plum, muted charcoal violet, coral orange, molten gold and warm cream. No explosion, destruction, burning forest, threatening creatures, buildings or people.
